Frontend player flow renders dashboard + all four hubs (Shop, Jobs, Businesses, Social) without 404/500/blank pages. critical_code_review_comments: TuningPanel.save() sends {tuning: clean} and admin PUT /admin/config does {$set: body} on the whole config document, so submitting a partial `tuning` object would REPLACE the full tuning dict (not merge). Since the frontend always sends the full tuning object it works today; if any future admin form saves a partial tuning key, other knobs will be wiped. Consider a shallow-merge server-side (e.g., {$set: {'tuning.key': val}} or fetch-merge-store) to make this robust.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily set skill_decay_per_hour to 0 during the persistence test, then restored the three new tuning knobs to their documented defaults (0.35 / 1.5 / 1.0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend split into core.py + routes/{player,economy,business,social,admin}.py is transparent — no API path changes. Admin sub-tab testids use lowercase label (e.g., admin-tab-tuning). Save button testid is 'save-tuning'. Toast component may render duplicate toast nodes but only one visible. TUNE_FIELDS is a static list in Admin.jsx — new tuning keys added by backend must also be added there or they won't be editable in UI.
